::: {.pm-hello}
# Hi, we're Peter and Marta.

We live in Somerville, Massachusetts. Our friends call the two of us PeteMart, which is how this site ended up at petem.art.

We'll post things we've made and places we've been, and now and then something with equations in it.
:::
